t: 一场灾难性的地震袭击了安提阿克,造成包括保皇党人欧普拉修斯在内的数千人死亡.
te: A catastrophic earthquake hits Antioch, killing several thousands including patriarch Euphrasius.

t: 当年早些时候教宗约翰一世去世后,教皇费利克斯四世当选.
te: Election of Pope Felix IV following the death of Pope John I earlier that year.
